_comment: Depth gate D — mutation testing. Scoped to the engine CORE (rule-engine + the selector factory) where a survived mutant is a real test hole; deliberately NOT the whole surface. Uses the command runner because this repo drives a bespoke vm/classic-script harness no framework plugin understands; coverageAnalysis must be 'off' for the command runner, so each mutant reruns the whole command — hence tests/mutation-run.js is a fast, single-process, in-process oracle (~0.24s, no child spawns) rather than the 24s full run-all. Run with `npm run test:mutation` (~3 min). Kept OUT of per-PR CI: a legitimate refactor can move the score, so this is a periodic/manual gate, not a PR blocker. Baseline score at introduction: 53.40% (rule-engine 58.73%, factory 44.94%). The 3.15 specs/prices split (region files carry prices only; vCPU/memory/family moved to {P}_SPECS.compute) broke tests/mutation-run.js's dry run from that point on — it loaded a region file without also loading its specs blob, so every 'rec:' recommendation-loop assertion failed 'No data available' and Stryker could never get past the initial test run. No mutant was scored between the split and 3.19.31, when the missing loads were restored. The real, honest score measured then was 40.24% (main, pre-3.19, scored the same way: 40.37% — confirming this is old drift, not a 3.19 regression). Break is set below THAT as the new RATCHET floor — raise it as the oracle grows, never lower it.
